newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 5.55 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 5.55 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.55 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with one-month HIBOR of 6.17788 percent at 0300 GMT. Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$7.68 billion.
The average accepted yield for the 90-day Exchange Fund bill was 5.62 percent compared with three-month HIBOR of 6.23077 percent at 0300 GMT. Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue were HK$4.81 billion.
The average accepted yield for the 180-day Exchange Fund bill was 5.68 percent compared to six-month HIBOR of 6.28846 percent. Bids for the HK$1.0 billion issue were HK$3.09 billion.
